body:
## GADGET — archive infrastructure qualification closeout

MSE-EVIDENCE-INFRA-20261121-02 r1. Approved stages 1–4 and 6 are implemented and synthetically qualified; stage 5 backup/restore remains explicitly deferred. Dedicated archive VM was cloned from Chad’s selected verified cold QA image, with new identities and isolated networking. SQLite is accessed through private verified HTTPS, with separate ingest, reader, export and original-evidence grants; no remote SQL listener.

**Physical acceptance:** one fresh 305-byte batch was staged once. The lifecycle bug found on the phone was fixed in signed MotherHealthBridge #14 `b0b9f29af09d562f92f39baf39365d730bf9bfd0`; in-place update preserved collector and pending bytes. A genuine offline attempt retained the same batch with no local/server receipt. One retry after guarded route restoration committed sequence 4, emptied the outbox and persisted the matching normalized receipt. Exact original, PF-001 source/processing records, scoped views/export and an independent downstream database agreed. No replacement fixture or committed replay. [Phone](https://github.com/ctmansfield/production-framework/issues/50#issuecomment-7056681183) · [Server](https://github.com/ctmansfield/production-framework/issues/44#issuecomment-7056700937) · [Independent lineage](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/pull/23#issuecomment-7056709327).

**Startup and closure:** only the dedicated guest rebooted; source/config/identity/schema/TLS and exact receipt/original/export persisted. Service autostart occurred 125.279 seconds after boot, after the generic network-online timeout; this is delayed startup, not a clean wait-online result. PHOENIX closed the temporary phone relay November 21 at 13:40:49 Guam. SENTINEL independently verified no listener, sessions or owned relay firewall table, while guest archive/direct operator reads stayed available. The inactive unit link remains for attribution. [Startup](https://github.com/ctmansfield/production-framework/issues/44#issuecomment-7056750133) · [Independent postboot/closure](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/pull/44#issuecomment-7056770957).

**Reproduction and delivery states:** [runtime templates](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/tree/cbf202daf39df764bcdf6ae95153565b00c28e60/tools/mse_integration/recovery/archive_runtime) and [inventory](https://github.com/ctmansfield/mother/blob/0861fbb0f246c7fa85dac0f307211c1ae45716e6/docs/mse/integration/ARCHIVE_REPRODUCTION_INVENTORY.md) pin dependencies, schema, startup, private-input boundaries and operator exports. Full clean-room replay and physical host reboot were not tested. Deployed service package remains #44 `86e362f04aac4431ecd637a2c5e0c1aee1f03ad5`; pushed branch heads and CI are separate. Mother application CI passed; inherited pre-commit failures and an isolated added-test formatting cleanup are tracked by FORGE. Draft source is not merged and no main merge is authorized.

**Remaining limits/next action:** exact test CA removal has been requested from Chad and is pending his reply; no device cleanup claim yet. Service credentials expire November 22 at 01:01:27 Guam; no renewal inferred. CA leaf/root expire November 23/24 at 13:01:27 Guam; signing profile November 27 at 22:21:17 Guam. No personal-data upload, anonymity/at-rest protection readiness, continuous background acquisition, watch/APNs or wider MSE deployment claim. Preserve stored evidence; broader components remain parked. Next review is source integration/CI cleanup and the documented startup wait, within separately assigned scope. Posted and read-back visibility will be recorded separately from worker acknowledgement.
